description: This file contains the implementation of the xajax JavaScript library version 0.2.4, including functions for DOM manipulation, AJAX requests, event handling, and response processing.

classes.name: Xajax
classes.description: Main class providing AJAX request handling, DOM manipulation, and response processing functionalities.
